text: A woman, likely late teens to early thirties, stands barefoot beside a throne. She has long dark hair, an oval face with defined eyes and lips. Wearing a deep purple draped gown with gold trim, a black belt, and a red jewel at the waist. One leg is raised, resting on the throne’s armrest. Her hands grip the ornate armrests. Behind her looms a large, coiled serpent statue. The setting appears ancient, stone-walled, dimly lit.
